title: Collage Moods
description: Five independent zine-collage pages, each a different emotional register — manifesto, poetic cut-up, protest, anti-fashion, and DIY map.
creative_direction: Independent studies of different collage voices. Each page feels made by a different zinemaker with a different emotional pitch, mapping the diversity of imperfect-by-design collage sensibilities.
